dedupe_keys.name: merra2 derived time series of european country aggregate electricity demand wind power generation and solar power generation

description: MERRA2 derived time series of European country-aggregate electricity demand, wind power generation and solar power generation is a data set deposited in bl.reading by its authors Hannah Bloomfield, David Brayshaw. The MERRA2 reanalysis data (1980-2018) has been used to calculate the hourly, country aggregated wind and solar power generation for 28 European countries based on a distribution of wind and solar farms which is considered to be representative of the current situation (2017). Coverage: continental; the metadata date the deposit to 2020. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related records: none catalogued yet for this repository.
